text:
Outside the voice

perhaps an offering

more living and vehement

than the burning memory

that clenches in my arms.


Embers of light fall

from a tormented sky.

Will they be at last

contours of love

so long awaited

for a real world?


Obsessed with the question I am.

To exist through words,

insolent vocation.




1974

translation.title: Outside the Voice...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the difficult opening and the final vocation to exist through words.
